note: The served recipe's seed floor, and whether averaging seeds helps it: the 615 + within-race readings at 6000 rounds, seed 42 cached from iteration 40, against the same at seeds 7 and 11. On the quick recipe (iteration 39's arms) the seeds disagree by 0.17 in log price a runner and the mean of three beats each by -0.0096 to -0.0110 (Brier skill +0.0008 to +0.0028); the served recipe subsamples less and learns slower, so its spread and the averaging gain are expected to be smaller. The three-seed average is built from the arms' prediction files and compared to each member.
